prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a hit while turning left. The patient had 13 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1102; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Records show long-standing treatment for the same condition before the crash; most of the current complaints come from it.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck while turning left. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported symptoms of concussion, and the force involved is in keeping with the head trauma described. Over the course of 13 visits, care followed a typical progression, with visit frequency tapering as the patient's symptoms improved. Examination findings are supportive of a concussive injury in some domains, while other testing was within normal limits. It should be noted that the records document prior, long-standing treatment for the same condition before this incident, and a substantial portion of the current complaints appear to reflect that pre-existing condition rather than the acute event. Billing records reflect single charges for each service, with no duplicate or repeated billing observed. Further evaluation is recommended to clarify the extent to which the present presentation is attributable to the collision.
